title: Recorded calls of each check-doc-links operation: what it was given and what it returned

states.title: markdownLinks returned the target and line of each inline link and skipped links inside code spans and fenced blocks
codePaths returned each backticked repository source path with its line and skipped unticked, extensionless and fenced paths
headingAnchors slugged each heading as GitHub does, numbered repeats, and found no anchors in prose or fenced text
brokenDocLinks returned no problems when every link resolves, and one sorted line for each broken link, owner path or missing checked document
